scene.speaker: diego
scene.bubble: Breaking news: Kili's lost-and-found box is FULL. Whose are all these things?

activities.title: Match the question with the answer.

items.sentence: This umbrella isn't ___. Mine is red.
These books belong to my parents. They're ___.

activities.title: Listen. Diego finds the owners. Write a name in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (detective) y Kili (asistente con la caja).
data.script: Diego: First object: a blue scarf with white stars. … Diego: That's easy — it's Ingrid's! She wears it every winter. … Diego: Next: small round glasses. … Diego: They're Maya's, of course. She can't read without them. … Diego: A guitar pick, orange like a carrot… … Diego: That's Oliver's! His whole collection is orange. … Diego: A little bell on a red ribbon? … Diego: Kili, that's yours! It's from your mail bag! … Diego: And the last thing… a torch. Hmm. Oh! It's mine! I lost it last month!

questions.q: The blue scarf with stars is …'s.

data.text: Each student puts one small object on the desk (a pencil, a key ring…). Mix them. Take turns asking: "Whose is this?" — "I think it's Carla's." Check with the owner!

activities.title: A and B are not the same. Find out why!
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 12 differences and tell your partner about them.

homework.prompt: Write 4 sentences about things in your house and their owners: The red mug is my dad's. The plants are my grandma's.
